neighbours.label: persistence words: 'ging' in 'nagging' and 'lingering'/'linger' (something that will not go away)
fire: She had a nagging cough that lasted most of the winter.
There was a lingering smell of smoke in the hallway.
He could not shake a nagging feeling that something was wrong.
The guests liked to linger over coffee after dinner.
A lingering doubt kept him awake for most of the night.
The team is dealing with a nagging knee injury to its captain.
Some fans lingered outside the stadium long after the match.
Her parents' constant nagging finally made him clean his room.
